Place: Magnolia Residence (2 rooms). Check-in. Aerobus 500 airport → Lido (see Buses).

Start of day (to trail): Checkout Magnolia. 008 → Centro → Campo da Barca. 701 08:30 → Machico (Larano start). Miss 08:30: 826 10:00 (Machico ~11:00) or 827 10:30.
End of day (from trail): Walk Larano into Porto da Cruz (hotel on foot). Paulo check-in after 15:00. Skip the walk: stay on 826 (via Portela) or 827 (via Maroços) to PdC.

Other lodging option: Casa Os Manos 2× singles $525 CAD (true 2 rooms; get off 850 at Faial).

End of day (from trail): 850 Ribeiro Frio 14:13 (Faial 14:40, Santana 14:55) or 18:40 (19:20 / 19:35). Til: stay on to Santana. Os Manos: get off Faial. Early finish: 801 10:42.

Place: Casa do Til (same 12–14 booking). PR1 last open day (closed 14–17).
Other lodging option: Same as the 12th: Os Manos if 2 rooms. Do not go Santo da Serra / Poiso (no bus ER 202).
Start of day (to trail): Taxi Santana/Faial → Pico do Areeiro (~45–60 min; leave ~1 h before the SIMplifica slot). Táxis Santana +351 291 572 540. No bus to the summit.
End of day (from trail): One-way PR1 to Ruivo, PR1.2 down to Achada do Teixeira, then taxi back to the same Santana/Faial hotel.

Other lodging option: Jardim Atlântico $237. Valley backup: Nature Spot Cottage $506.
End of day (from trail): After PR6: shuttle up before 18:00 (€5) Casa Florestal → ER 105, then pre-booked taxi to the coast hotel (Calheta 291 822 129). Cottage backup: no evening taxi.

Place: Mini-house (Xavier) 2 beds $201 CAD. 5 min to Fanal trail.
Other lodging option: Basalto / Cobalt in Seixal (~$301 / $365) if the valley bed goes. Casa da Nogueira not on Booking.
Start of day (to trail): Taxi 07:00–07:30 hotel → ER 105 car park (not the cottage door). Walk down 20–40 min, then Fio toward Chão. Cottage backup: start at the door.
End of day (from trail): Arrive on foot at the mini-house. No bus into the valley. Seixal town (~15 min) is the bus/taxi fallback.

Other lodging option: Euro Moniz ~$252. Skip Costa Azul / Ribeirinho (2-night min).
Start of day (to trail): On foot from the mini-house (5 min to Fanal trail). No bus.
End of day (from trail): Walk in from Fanal to Porto Moniz centre.

Other lodging option: Alto Lido if the flight is early (Aerobus stop 15).

Place: Bella Vista (same 17–19 booking). Last night. Recovery — no second PR1. Fly Sat 19 morning.
Other lodging option: Same as the 17th: Alto Lido if the flight is early.
